analysis: That rough start on 1 August — under five hours with no deep sleep recorded — could have derailed the whole week, but you didn't let it. You bounced straight back into the sevens for three solid nights, and that 7h 22m on the fifth night with nearly two hours of REM is genuinely gorgeous. The 6th was a wobble — almost two hours awake is a lot, and the deep sleep dropped to just 28 minutes — but then your most recent night came back with 1h 8m of deep and a 2h 3m REM that is frankly showing off. Five out of seven nights above six and a half hours, and your body clearly knows what it's doing when you let the wind-down routine do its thing.
